title: Medicinal-species coverage audit (independent verification of prior claims)
question: How many COMPADRE / Environmental-Demography / PhenObs taxa have documented medicinal use in open checklists, and do the prior-agent claims (>=333, >=68, >=307) replicate?
hypothesis: Counts will be lower than prior claims because open checklists (USDA Duke, Herbolario) replace restricted Kew WCUPS/MPNS; each dataset still exceeds 10 medicinal species with usable outcomes.
data: COMPADRE 6.26.3.0; GBIF backbone; USDA Duke ETHNOBOT; Herbolario; EnvDemog GLMMdata; PhenObs 2019-2023
method: GBIF accepted+true synonyms, manual synonym review, binomial match
finding: All three datasets pass the >=10 medicinal-species threshold; the larger prior counts are not reproduced with open checklists.

envdemog.note: complete-case modelling table (121 pops); raw-record denominator differs
